outdated_runtime.cause: builders copy nativ_generation and nativ_<modality> into each runtime and workers import that copy, so an app update leaves the old worker code in place until Repair
outdated_runtime.measured_on_5288300c: submit HTTP 409 runtime_outdated before any job or worker; the model list still showed the profile ready
outdated_runtime.since_2e5bf71e_from_code: readiness unavailable with 'Repair this runtime: it holds worker code from another Nativ build.'; submit 409 provider_unavailable with that reason; dispatch and recovery still refused with runtime_outdated as a second line; not yet measured on the M3
outdated_runtime.granularity: a nativ_video-only change left the music runtimes valid (a Stable job succeeded without Repair); a nativ_generation change needs one Repair per installed profile, without download
